pull.body:
## What

Adds `worker/concurrent.go` — parallel helpers for the settlement worker:

- `AggregateTotals` / `SafeAggregate` — per-payer totals across batches
- `CountAll` — parallel claim count
- `CollectIDs` — gather claim ids
- `NotifyFirst` / `BufferedFanIn` — small channel helpers
- `SafeStore` — a guarded accumulator
- `Config` — lazy one-time config init
- `Poll` — tick until done

## Testing

`gofmt`, `go vet`, `go build`, `go test` all pass locally.

---

  - Added support for concurrent claim aggregation, counting, notification, and ID collection.
  - Improved safety when storing and aggregating shared data.
  - Added polling and buffered data-processing support.
  - Added one-time configuration initialization to provide consistent runtime behavior.

**Register workers before launch and synchronize `totals`.**
